_doc: Painted zones on the campaign map (Systems/Wilds.cs). The mayor paints cells of the wilds: explore zones post a council commission again and again until a company has walked every cell; patrol zones hire riders for a daily wage to ride them, cutting caravan raids on the roads through them, seeing raiders sooner and meeting trouble on the way. Distances are days of march, wages gold a day.

explore._doc: A trip's pay is the survey reward of the zone's region times (base + perCell for each unseen cell up to tripCells). The company explores daysBase + daysPerCell for each unseen cell, at most maxDays, and sees every cell whose centre comes within sight.

patrol._doc: Hired riders cover riderCells cells; each soldier of a regiment sent to ride it covers soldierCells times its unit's patrol. Cover (0 to 1) is what they can ride over the zone's size. A patrolled road keeps raidCut less of its raid chance and gives its settlement security; a raid that sets out from or crosses patrolled ground is seen warnHours sooner. Each day the riders may meet something (meetPerCell a cell, at most meetMost), rolled on the zone's own dice.
meets: a pack of wolves stalking a drover's string
goblin scouts skulking along a ridge
an owlbear in the brush beside the road
a band of gnolls following the herds
